ios.desc:
It's both easy and hard. And it trains your visual concentration! You're going to love this memory puzzle game!

Blackout is a super fun memory puzzle game where you need to remember a pattern before the shadow comes. The game contains many different playing modes. Some levels are just basic colors, some levels you need to tap the tiles in the correct color order and some levels rotate before you can start tapping. And there are even more modes! Since Blackout contains more than 100 levels, there will definitely be tons of fun solving the different memory puzzles.

If you're looking for a relaxing game which also helps you increase your memory and concentration skills, look no further. Blackout - memory game will be the perfect game for you!

Game features:
-Over 100 levels. And more are coming!
-Trains your brain and memory
-Many different game modes
-Increase your visual concentration
-Free to play
-Come back every day for a daily reward

FAQ

How to play Blackout?

When you start a level you will see a pattern of colored tiles. After a couple of seconds, all of the tiles will be dark. Now you need to remember what the pattern looked like and tap the tiles according to the objective.

How many levels does Blackout have?

Currently, there are 105 levels. We continue to improve the game continuously, as well as adding more levels.

Will the progress be saved?

Of course. Close the game and come back whenever you want.

Is the whole game free?

Blackout is free to download and play. However, you've only got five lives. If you make five mistakes and have zero lives left, you can either wait up to 20 minutes or pay 10 coins to refill. There is also a Flash that gives you a quick glance at the pattern. You'll receive three of these when you start the game. More of these can also be bought for more in-game coins.
